description:
AWARD WINNING homes in Leith, come discover why we were recently named BEST IN SCOTLAND.

Find your home to rent in Leith, one of the top 20 coolest neighbourhoods in the world, according to Time Out.

Our 2-bedroom apartments feature an open-plan layout that seamlessly integrates the kitchen, living, and dining areas. The fully integrated kitchen includes a hob, oven, dishwasher, and fridge freezer. Bedrooms are equipped with storage space and a modern bathroom with a shower over the bath and mirrored storage cabinets. Additionally, main bedrooms benefit from a ensuite with overhead shower and each apartment offers convenient storage space with an installed washer-dryer machine. 

When you rent a PLATFORM_ home, you'll enjoy for free: 
- Exclusive access to a residents-only gym
- Yoga, and spin studio
- A kids' soft playroom
- Two co-working spaces
- A private dining area ideal for socialising with friends
- On-site guest rooms for extended stays
- Easy access to the roof terraces through the Sun Lounge 
 
All of our homes are fitted with: 
- Expertly designed, integrated kitchens 
- Broadband included in your rent
 
PLATFORM_ is located in the heart of Leith with transport links nearby via tram and train across the City. Plus, being part of this thriving community you are only a short distance from everything you need, including: 

- 10 minutes to the City Centre
- 5-minutes to Leith Shore 
- Water of Leith Walkway in 2 mins
- Convenience store and coffee shop coming soon on-site
